children: Our 2026 Half Year Report is now available on our website (in English and Traditional Chinese) at https://www.prudentialplc.com/en/investors/results-and-reports/all-reports/.

In compliance with the Rules Governing the Listing of Securities on The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited, printed copies of the 2026 Half Year Report will be sent as soon as practicable after publication to shareholders on the Hong Kong share register who have elected to receive a paper copy.

The 2026 Half Year Report has been submitted to the National Storage Mechanism and will shortly be available for inspection at www.fca.org.uk/markets/primary-markets/regulatory-disclosures/national-storage-mechanism.

Prudential provides life and health insurance and asset management in Greater China, ASEAN, India and Africa. Prudential's mission is to be the most trusted partner and protector for this generation and generations to come, by providing simple and accessible financial and health solutions. The business has dual primary listings on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong
. It also has a secondary listing on the Singapore Stock Exchange
and a listing on the New York Stock Exchange

in the form of American Depositary Receipts. It is a constituent of the Hang Seng Composite Index and is also included for trading in the Shenzhen-Hong Kong Stock Connect programme and the Shanghai-Hong Kong Stock Connect programme.

Prudential is not affiliated in any manner with Prudential Financial, Inc. a company whose principal place of business is in the United States of America, nor with The Prudential Assurance Company Limited, a subsidiary of M&G plc, a company incorporated in the United Kingdom
